name: [Element] Ball
fullDescription: Conjures a compact, spherical orb of compressed energy to launch at a single opponent.

name: [Element] Arrow
fullDescription: Manifests a piercing, high-velocity projectile ideal for long-range marksmen.

name: [Element] Blade
fullDescription: Coats a physical weapon or creates a solid energy edge to add elemental damage to melee swings.

name: [Element] Shield
fullDescription: Erects a flat, floating plane of energy in front of the caster to block incoming frontal attacks.

name: [Element] Spark
fullDescription: Discharges a tiny, sudden burst of energy from the fingertips to distract or inflict minor status triggers.

name: [Element] Mist
fullDescription: Releases a low-density, localized vapor cloud that obscure vision and lightly applies elemental attributes.

name: [Element] Strike
fullDescription: Infuses a standard physical punch or kick with a sudden, explosive elemental impact.

name: [Element] Spray
fullDescription: Emits a continuous, short-range stream of raw energy from the palms, resembling a flamethrower.

name: [Element] Step
fullDescription: Leaves a brief elemental trail underfoot that grants a minor burst of movement speed.

name: [Element] Trap
fullDescription: Places an invisible glyph on the floor that erupts with elemental force when stepped on by an enemy.

name: [Element] Needle
fullDescription: Fires a rapid cluster of microscopic, needle-sharp energy points to pierce light armor defenses.

name: [Element] Aura
fullDescription: Envelops the user’s body in a thin, visible layer of energy, slightly boosting local elemental resistance.

name: [Element] Wall
fullDescription: Raises a tall, solid barrier from the ground to split the battlefield and block enemy pathing.

name: [Element] Lance
fullDescription: Forges a heavy, high-penetration throwing spear capable of piercing through multiple aligned targets.

name: [Element] Ring
fullDescription: Expels an expanding, horizontal shockwave ring outwards from the user to push back nearby flankers.

name: [Element] Whip
fullDescription: Shapes a flexible, mid-range tether used to pull, bind, or slash opponents from a distance.

name: [Element] Cloak
fullDescription: Clothes the user in thick energy that damages melee attackers and protects against matching element debuffs.

name: [Element] Trap
fullDescription: Drops a continuous, hazardous puddle on the terrain that slows down and damages anyone standing inside it.

name: [Element] Clone
fullDescription: Crafts an unstable decoy duplicate that explodes with elemental feedback when destroyed by an enemy.

name: [Element] Burst
fullDescription: Triggers a localized explosion directly centered on an object or a pre-marked target from afar.

name: [Element] Shards
fullDescription: Summons a floating semi-circle of sharp projectiles that can be fired sequentially or all at once.

name: [Element] Breath
fullDescription: Channels an upfront, medium-range cone of dense elemental destruction mimicking a lesser monster attack.

name: [Element] Bullet
fullDescription: Fires high-frequency, rapid-succession pellets of concentrated energy at the cost of high stamina.

name: [Element] Bind
fullDescription: Manifests energy shackles around a target’s limbs to temporarily lock their physical mobility.

name: [Element] Torrent
fullDescription: Unleashes a wide, continuous linear beam of devastating energy that requires stationary channeling.

name: [Element] Armor
fullDescription: Materializes a heavy, full-body suit of crystallized energy that significantly raises maximum health values.

name: [Element] Spike
fullDescription: Commands a massive jagged column to erupt violently from directly underneath an enemy's feet.

name: [Element] Vortex
fullDescription: Generates a swirling gravitational anomaly that pulls loose objects and enemies toward its center.

name: [Element] Rain
fullDescription: Opens a portal in the sky to shower a medium-sized zone with hundreds of falling energy projectiles.

name: [Element] Mine
fullDescription: Buries a delayed-activation explosive charges that detonate with massive area-of-effect damage.

name: [Element] Wave
fullDescription: Swings a weapon to discharge a sweeping, crescent-shaped kinetic cutting projection across the floor.

name: [Element] Enchant
fullDescription: Temporarily alters the basic material properties of an ally's gear to mimic a chosen element.

name: [Element] Bomb
fullDescription: Hurls a heavy, slow-moving projectile that detonates into a lingering cloud of volatile elemental residue.

name: [Element] Chains
fullDescription: Summons tracking energy constructs that lock onto an enemy and drain their mana pools over time.

name: [Element] Pillar

name: [Element] Hammer
fullDescription: Creates a massive, spectral blunt weapon overhead that slams down to shatter enemy guarding stances.

name: [Element] Tempest
fullDescription: Stirs up a violent, localized storm system that dominates a large section of the battlefield map.

name: [Element] Cage

name: [Element] Golem
fullDescription: Summons a powerful elemental construct to fight alongside the caster.

name: [Element] Beam
fullDescription: Fires a concentrated beam of energy that pierces through multiple targets.

name: [Element] Eruption

name: [Element] Nova
fullDescription: Releases a massive, blinding flash of omnidirectional energy expanding rapidly from the caster’s body.

name: [Element] Dragon
fullDescription: Summons a colossal, serpentine dragon made of pure energy to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

name: [Element] Meteor
fullDescription: Hurls a massive celestial object from the sky to crash into the battlefield.

name: [Element] Tsunami
fullDescription: Rolls a massive, vertical tidal wave of elemental force across the field, clearing out all light units.

name: [Element] Curse
fullDescription: Afflicts a target with a permanent negative status effect.

name: [Element] Domain
fullDescription: Covers the immediate area in a personal field, boosting the user's stats while crippling trespassers.

name: [Element] Phantom
fullDescription: Summons a spectral entity made of pure energy to assist the caster in battle.

name: [Element] Cataclysm
fullDescription: Completely alters the local environment, triggering a continent-scale geographic permanent disaster.

name: [Element] Singularity
fullDescription: Condenses energy into a microscopic point that collapses, erasing all space and objects within radius.

name: [Element] Judgment
fullDescription: Summons an absolute cosmic descending execution beam from the outer atmosphere down onto the world.

name: [Element] Eclipse
fullDescription: Swallows the sky in a massive elemental blanket, completely cutting off natural sunlight or ambient external mana.

name: [Element] Rebirth
fullDescription: Triggers a total cellular and spiritual reconstruction, resurrecting the caster at peak structural power levels.

name: [Element] Annihilation

name: [Element] Genesis

name: [Element] Apocalypse
fullDescription: Unfurls a massive array of hundreds of magic circles that simultaneously bomb a city-sized territory.

name: [Element] Avatar

name: [Element] Execution

name: [Element] Extinction
fullDescription: Emits a slow-moving, global shockwave that permanently strips away specific elemental attributes from targets.

name: [Element] Overlord
fullDescription: Grants the caster absolute, unchallenged mental command over every lesser elemental manifestation or entity in the world.

name: Hellfire Eruption
fullDescription: Erupts black flames from the ground that burn until the target is reduced to ash.

name: Combustion Trigger
fullDescription: Instantly detonates the oxygen pockets surrounding a target, causing a sudden, localized explosion.

name: Phoenix Rebirth
fullDescription: A passive cheat-death spell that consumes the user in flames upon a fatal blow and revives them with partial health.

name: Heat Wave Mirage

name: Supernova Core
fullDescription: Generates a mini-star in the caster's hand that slowly cooks everything within a mile radius until it detonates.

name: Water Breathing

name: Hydraulic Sever
fullDescription: Fires an ultra-thin, hyper-pressurized line of water that slices through armor and metal shields like a laser.

name: Blood Boil

name: Dehydration Touch
fullDescription: Instantly extracts all moisture from a living target, leaving them a desiccated husk.

name: Tidal Convergence
fullDescription: Commands the nearest major body of water to rise up and roll across the landscape as a massive tsunami.

name: Seismic Sensor
fullDescription: Allows the caster to map out structural terrain and detect hidden tunnels by sending vibrations through the ground.

name: Petrification Gaze

name: Continental Fracture
fullDescription: Slams the ground to tear open a bottomless, miles-long chasm, swallowing entire armies.

name: Vacuum Sphere
fullDescription: Removes all air around an enemy's head, completely suffocating them and preventing voice-activated spellcasting.

name: Sonic Boom Blade
fullDescription: Compresses air currents into a sharp, invisible kinetic slicing wave that travels faster than sound.

name: Atmospheric Lift
fullDescription: Manipulates low-pressure zones to effortlessly levitate and fly across vast distances.

name: Electromagnetic Pulse
fullDescription: Releases a static surge that permanently paralyzes mechanical constructs or scrambles magi-tech devices.

name: Nerve Overload
fullDescription: Delivers a minor shock to an opponent's nervous system, scrambling their motor skills and causing involuntary spasms.

name: Chain Lightning Storm
fullDescription: Discharges a cloud-shattering arc of electricity that jumps from target to target, multiplying in damage with each bounce.

name: Absolute Zero Dome
fullDescription: Drops the local temperature to absolute zero, completely stopping molecular movement and freezing magic arrays mid-air.

name: Frostbite Kiss
fullDescription: Freezes the moisture on an enemy's skin instantly, causing severe tissue necrosis and numbing their reflexes.

name: Glacial Sepulcher
fullDescription: Traps a target inside a crystalline pillar of ice that seals their life force away in eternal stasis.

name: Photosynthetic Surge
fullDescription: Draws light energy from the sun to rapidly regenerate the caster's health and stamina.

name: Parasitic Seed
fullDescription: Plants a microscopic spore inside an enemy that feeds on their mana to sprout external vines.

name: Thorn Labyrinth
fullDescription: Erupts a massive wall of razor-sharp, self-regenerating briars that bleed anyone who touches them.

name: Ferrous Pull
fullDescription: Magnetizes an enemy’s weapons or heavy armor, forcibly pulling them toward the caster or pinning them to the floor.

name: Liquefy Alloy

name: Volcanic Vent
fullDescription: Pierces the earth to create a direct conduit to the world's mantle, spewing continuous rivers of sticky magma.

name: Warp Gate
fullDescription: Tears open two interconnected spatial portals across vast distances for instantaneous mass transport.

name: Gravitational Collapse
fullDescription: Multiplies the local gravity threshold tenfold, flattening enemies to the floor and crushing bones.

name: Pocket Dimension
fullDescription: Banishes a target into an isolated, empty spatial vacuum outside the fabric of reality.

name: Temporal Acceleration
fullDescription: Speeds up the cellular time clock of a wound, forcing it to instantly heal—or fast-forwarding an object's rust and decay.

name: Chronos Paradox
fullDescription: Places an enemy in a continuous three-second time loop, repeating their last action endlessly.

name: World Rewind
fullDescription: Rewinds the time state of the entire battlefield by exactly ten seconds, reviving dead allies.

name: Singularity Rift
fullDescription: Opens a microscopic hole of pure nothingness that deletes physical and magical matter out of existence upon contact.

name: Neurotoxin Cloud
fullDescription: Releases a thick violet gas that causes blindness, hallucinations, and rapid motor skill failure.

name: Marrow Melt
fullDescription: Fires a jet of highly concentrated chemical acid that eats away skin, muscle, and bone in seconds.

name: Blood Puppet
fullDescription: Manipulates the iron and liquid iron inside an exposed wound, taking physical command of the target's limbs.

name: Crimson Pact
fullDescription: Sacrifices a portion of the caster's own physical health pool to double the damage of their next spell strike.

name: Ossuary Armor

name: Corpse Explosion

name: Eardrum Rupture
fullDescription: Emits an ultra-high frequency acoustic pitch that permanently deafens targets and shatters glass.

name: Resonance Shatter
fullDescription: Matches the molecular frequency of an enemy's shield, causing it to explode into dust through vibration alone.

name: Dream Eat
fullDescription: Traps a sleeping or dazed enemy in a permanent nightmare, feeding on their mana pool while they remain catatonic.

name: Cognitive Inversion
fullDescription: Swaps an enemy’s sensory perceptions, making left feel like right, and up feel like down.

name: Purge Corruption
fullDescription: Instantly evaporates curses, demonic seals, parasitic infections, and shadow magic.

name: Judgment Day
fullDescription: Calls down a colossal pillar of pure, unfiltered divine energy from the troposphere onto a designated city grid.

name: Shadow Stitch
fullDescription: Pins an opponent’s physical shadow to the floor with an enchanted dagger, entirely paralyzing their true body.

name: Nightmare Shroud
fullDescription: Blinds a target by covering their eyes in sentient shadows that project their deepest psychological fears.

name: Cosmic Adaptability
fullDescription: Passive trait that doubles the learning and mastery acquisition speed of any new weapon or magic school.

name: Spirit Sight
fullDescription: Allows the user to perceive the flow of ambient mana lines, hidden magical traps, and invisible spirits.

name: Subterranean Echo
fullDescription: Grants a spatial radar sense through the feet to detect moving underground threats, hollow walls, and hidden mineral veins.

name: Feral Surge
fullDescription: Triggers an instinctive burst of adrenaline, doubling short-range movement speed and raw physical striking power for 10 seconds.

name: Draconic Majesty
fullDescription: Emits a faint, passive aura of draconic weight that lowers the attack attributes of weaker surrounding monster races.

name: Calamity Breath
fullDescription: Discharges a cataclysmic torrent of pure, un-elementalized draconic energy that annihilates matter, structures, and magic fields.

name: Siren Call
fullDescription: Uses vocal frequencies to completely charm, disorient, or mentally dominate land-dwelling targets near bodies of water.

name: Nocturnal Mist
fullDescription: Allows the user to dissolve their physical body into a cloud of ageless, invulnerable bats or shadow mist to escape danger.

name: Angel Wings
fullDescription: Grants permanent 3D flight mobility using holy feathered wings, completely bypassing land terrain obstacles.

name: Ethereal Phase
fullDescription: Allows the user to turn temporarily non-corporeal, passing directly through solid doors, walls, and non-enchanted weapons.

name: Calculated Protocol
fullDescription: Speeds up mind processing, eliminating casting failures and granting a permanent bonus to hitting structural weaknesses.

name: Guerilla Pack
fullDescription: Grants a small, stacking attribute bonus to strength and agility for every allied goblin fighting within the same zone.

name: Warlord Intimidation
fullDescription: A booming roar that inflicts a fear status, paralyzing lesser combatants and interrupting enemy spellcasters.

name: Hive Network
fullDescription: Connects sensory perceptions across all swarm members, preventing anyone from being surprised, flanked, or backstabbed.

name: Draconic Scales
fullDescription: Grants hardened biological skin patches that naturally reflect a portion of low-tier physical damage back at attackers.

name: Dhampir Regeneration
fullDescription: Allows the user to auto-heal surface wounds over time without daylight burning penalties, but requires occasional blood consumption.

name: Half-Elf Harmony
fullDescription: Combines human flexibility with elven magic sensitivity, allowing the user to dual-wield physical weapons while casting spells.

name: Thermal Retribution
fullDescription: Covers the user’s body in a micro-heat layer that burns any enemy who lands a close-quarters melee strike.

name: Fluid Counter

name: Rooted Stance
fullDescription: Grants total immunity to knockbacks, trips, or forced battlefield displacement as long as both feet touch the soil.

name: Vacuum Dodge
fullDescription: Creates a thin slipstream pocket around the body, lessening air friction to boost maximum dashing speed.

name: Static Discharge

name: Magnetic Deflection

name: Molten Retaliation

name: Shatter Frequency

name: Venomous Blood
fullDescription: Splatters toxic fluid onto attackers whenever the user takes a cutting or piercing wound.

name: Gravitational Anchor
fullDescription: Increases the user's effective physical weight on command, preventing them from being lifted by tornadoes or spatial pulls.

name: Chrono Backtrack

name: Null Void

name: Divine Aegis

name: Umbral Blend

name: Overload Core

name: Weapon Mastery

name: Shield Wall Paradigm

name: Vitality Threshold

name: Vitals Exposure
fullDescription: Grants a permanent, passive vision overlay highlighting the absolute weakest structural parts of an enemy's body.

name: Trajectory Calculation
fullDescription: Automatically factors in wind speed and elevation drops, eliminating long-range arrow inaccuracy.
